description:
*This webtoon was produced based on the web drama \[Chocolate Milk Shake\] and has a new story that is different from the web drama.* 

One day, two juniors, Ji-Kang Jeong and Go Yoo-Woo, appear in front of Jung-Woo, who had always been against each other in the department. Although they are faces that Jung-Woo is seeing for the first time, they are actually the dog and cat that Jung-Woo briefly took care of in the past, reincarnated as humans! However, Jung-Woo, who does not know where they are, is only embarrassed by their affectionate attitude. The two juniors, who chose to reincarnate for a short time for the lonely Jung-Woo, struggle to open Jung-Woo's heart... Will Jung-Woo be able to accept their sincerity? A warm and quirky healing romance begins now!

(Source: Bomtoon, translated)
